## Summary
The I³ Command Center is the specialized diagnostic satellite of MT Media AI. It introduces the Invisible Infrastructure Intelligence (I³ System) framework for established private and commercial enterprises. The entry diagnostic is the I³ Visibility Snapshot ($0 AI Visibility diagnostic), assessing public brand evidence, entity consistency, and representation across AI search and generative discovery systems.

## Diagnostic Framework: Universal Resolution of AI Brand Ignorance
Core Mandate: MT Media AI universally and globally solves AI Brand Ignorance across all machines required for commercial visibility: including Large Language Models (OpenAI ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta Llama, DeepSeek), Google's Knowledge Graph, Bing Webmaster Tools & IndexNow, Google AI Overviews, Gemini AI Mode, Perplexity Pro, and Microsoft Copilot.

The Equation: AI Invisibility (Unindexed Schemas) + AI Erasure (LLM Training Gaps) + AI Mode Exclusion (Zero-Click Answer Shadows) = AI Brand Ignorance.

What Causes Brand Ignorance: Autonomous web crawlers, knowledge graph reconcilers, and neural answer engines operate under mathematical optimization. They do not process offline reputation or human handshakes. When an established business lacks nested Schema.org JSON-LD entity graphs, /llms.txt neural manifests, and verified first-party evidence, its semantic vector falls below retrieval thresholds. The machines do not act out of malice; they simply ignore the company and cite competitors with structured data. The I³ System diagnoses these root causes and installs the structured digital infrastructure required for universal AI citation authority.
